lines.text: My flight got delayed again. Ugh!
I'm ticked off about the delay.

data.define: Used when something has made you angry.

example.text: I'm ticked off about the delay.

misuse.text: Don't say 'ticked off' about a checklist.

hook.text: My flight got delayed again. Ugh!

publish.title: What does "ticked off" mean?
publish.value: Ticked off = Really annoyed. Example: "I'm ticked off about the delay." (casual English, US).
